Pink blend Large-Flowered Climber.
Registration name: WEKrosopela
Exhibition name: Candy Land™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, before 2004).
Introduced in United States by Edmunds' Roses in 2007.
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2007.
rows.Bloom: Pink blend, stripes. Rosy pink shot with cream. Mild, tea fragrance. 9 to 18 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, semi-double to double, borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, climbing, spreading. Large, glossy, light green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 12' to 15' (365 to 455cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b through 9b. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Hardy. vigorous. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood.. Remove unproductive wood every third year or so.
